title: Gladiator
synopsis: A general becomes a slave, becomes a gladiator, becomes the thing that an emperor cannot kill quietly.

nodes.text: Wheat in your fingers, and a German emissary's head in the snow.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Mercy.
You commit to “Order the catapults.” The story records the instinct as “Soldier” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: The old emperor offers you Rome until his son returns.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Accept the burden.” The story records the instinct as “Duty” and carries it forward.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Honest.

nodes.text: He embraces his father a little too long. His father does not breathe again.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Bold.
There is no taking “Bide your time” back. Wise shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: Soldiers loyal to a name you do not say. Your wife and son already two days ahead.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Fight.” The story records the instinct as “Brave” and carries it forward.
You commit to “Ride.” The story records the instinct as “Desperate” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: You arrive too late and the world ends in a doorway.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Bury them.” The story records the instinct as “Honest” and carries it forward.
You commit to “Ride after the killers.” The story records the instinct as “Reckless” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: A trader in Zucchabar buys you cheap and feeds you better.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Train hard.” The story records the instinct as “Discipline” and carries it forward.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Stubborn—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: A circle of dirt and a man with a curved sword who wants your life.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Hard—follows you into whatever comes next.
“Show the crowd” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Cunning.

nodes.text: A Numidian asleep with a wooden carving of his daughter on his chest.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Speak” back. Friend shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Quiet.

nodes.text: Proximo says the only way to the emperor is the Colosseum.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Strategic—follows you into whatever comes next.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Stand alone.” The story records the instinct as “Brave” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: Crowd silent. Sword raised. Eyes on the emperor's box.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Defiant—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: Helm off. Names listed. An emperor learns whose face he has been watching.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Honest.

nodes.text: She slips into your cell with a plan and a small hand on yours.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Hope—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: Commodus has the boy at the end of a knife on her shoulder.

nodes.text: Commodus slips the wound under your armor before the duel begins.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Stoic.

nodes.text: A hundred thousand silent Romans, and a brother who does not understand he has lost.

choices.consequence: “Strike clean” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Justice.
“Drop the sword” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Mercy.
Some endings reveal themselves last.

nodes.text: You walk through the long grass toward a door you remember. The latch lifts. Someone calls your name in the voice that was always home.
Gracchus carries your body out and the people carry the rest. The Republic, for a season, almost works.
Juba buries the small wooden figures in the sand and stands. We will see you again, he says. But not yet. Not yet.
